name: PR416 Shot FM-03 severity evidence

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-shot-fm03-severity
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-shot-fm03-severity.yml
      - src/shot-mechanics/ShotExecutor.cs

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  focused-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-shot-fm03-severity
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify evidence delta
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "a7f2b77af61c1d0b7138bfdfce21cd1772c91f26"
          git diff --check a7f2b77af61c1d0b7138bfdfce21cd1772c91f26 -- src/shot-mechanics/ShotExecutor.cs
          changed="$(git diff --name-only a7f2b77af61c1d0b7138bfdfce21cd1772c91f26 -- 'src/**')"
          test "$changed" = "src/shot-mechanics/ShotExecutor.cs"

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run Shot Mechanics suite
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/shot-mechanics/Tests/shot-mechanics-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --logger "console;verbosity=normal"

      - name: Run MatchEngine tackle fixture plus shot outcome
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-shot-fm03
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "FullyQualifiedName~MatchEngineTackleTests|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-shot-fm03.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-shot-fm03 \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-shot-fm03/console.log

      - name: Verify current-PR acceptance outcomes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          files = glob.glob("artifacts/pr416-shot-fm03/*.trx")
          if len(files) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected one TRX, found {files}")
          wanted = {
              "AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed": "Passed",
              "BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose": "Passed",
              "TacklesHappenInComposedPlay": "Passed",
              "ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice": "NotExecuted",
              "sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes": "Passed",
          }
          root = ET.parse(files[0]).getroot()
          rows = []
          for elem in root.iter():
              if elem.tag.endswith("UnitTestResult"):
                  rows.append((elem.attrib.get("testName"), elem.attrib.get("outcome")))
          seen = {name: outcome for name, outcome in rows if name in wanted}
          save = [(name, outcome) for name, outcome in rows
                  if name and name.startswith("SaveAndRestoreCarryTheTackleLatches")]
          print("REFERENCE_TARGET_OUTCOMES", seen)
          print("SAVE_RESTORE_OUTCOMES", save)
          if seen != wanted:
              raise SystemExit(f"target mismatch: expected={wanted} actual={seen}")
          if len(save) != 2 or any(outcome != "Passed" for _, outcome in save):
              raise SystemExit(f"save/restore latch cases not both Passed: {save}")
          PY

      - name: Upload evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-shot-fm03-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-shot-fm03/
          if-no-files-found: warn
